hypothesis: Retain BF16 aggregation and exact QKV fusion, then memoize the two immutable formal CFG text contexts after caption projection/norm and each block's deterministic cross-attention K/V projection/norm/head reshape. Q, mask, SDPA, output projection, and all video-dependent work still execute on every call.

object_and_data_lifetime.formal_contexts: The denoising stage constructs pos_cond_kwargs and neg_cond_kwargs once before the step loop from batch.prompt_embeds[0] and batch.negative_prompt_embeds[0]. The same two branch kwargs objects remain in ctx and are passed by predict_fn on each of 50 steps; CFG is local/sequential, yielding exactly two stable source Tensor objects over 100 DiT calls.
object_and_data_lifetime.immutability: The runtime only reads encoder_hidden_states in caption_projection/norm and cross-attention projections. No in-place operation targets either source context, cached normalized caption, cached K, or cached V; SDPA consumes K/V read-only. The denoising stage runs under torch.no_grad, and the cache is disabled whenever gradients are enabled.
object_and_data_lifetime.strong_reference_safety: Each cache entry stores the source Tensor object itself and compares with `is`; while live, allocator storage and Python id cannot be freed/reused for another tensor.
object_and_data_lifetime.bounded_warmup_replacement: Every model-level and per-layer cache has capacity two. Warmup objects miss. As the formal cond/uncond objects arrive, LRU insertion evicts warmup entries; after both formal branches, only the two formal strong references/values remain. No cache grows with steps or requests.
object_and_data_lifetime.key_coverage: A hit requires exact source object identity plus device type/index, dtype, shape, stride, storage offset, data pointer, and available source version. It also requires current module-parameter identity, device, dtype, shape, data pointer, and mutation version.
object_and_data_lifetime.weight_lifecycle: Caches start empty on each module instance. K/V cache is owned by that SanaVideoCrossAttention instance, so values cannot cross layers/models. Parameters load and cast to BF16 before any forward; a later move, recast, replacement, or mutation changes the weight signature and forces recomputation. Fixed run has no LoRA, quantization, training, or offload of the transformer.
object_and_data_lifetime.aliasing: Cached values are outputs of deterministic read-only projections/norm/reshape and are retained, not copied into or aliased with video hidden-state storage. Downstream code never mutates them.

mathematical_equivalence.caption: For each fixed branch context c, cache exactly C=caption_norm(caption_projection(c)); later calls substitute the same C for recomputing the same deterministic expression.
mathematical_equivalence.cross_attention: For each layer and C, cache exactly K=reshape(norm_k(to_k(C))) and V=reshape(to_v(C)); every call still computes Q=reshape(norm_q(to_q(video_tokens))), applies the current mask, executes SDPA(Q,K,V), reshapes, and executes to_out.
mathematical_equivalence.off_identity: When SGLANG_SANA_XATTN_KV_CACHE is unset/0 or gradients are enabled, the original caption projection/norm and cross-attention K/V operations execute verbatim. Cache objects are absent and no cache helper runs.
mathematical_equivalence.no_approximation: No tensor is stale across a source/weight lifecycle change; no denoising step, DiT call, block, token, head, Q projection, SDPA, mask, output projection, self-attention, or FFN work is skipped. Only deterministic step-invariant local quantities are reused.

memory_estimate.note: Strong source references do not duplicate source storage already owned by the request; signatures/list metadata are negligible. Measured runtime peak is required after launch.

unit_gate.nonfatal_note: The exact environment emitted its known optional DeepGEMM import traceback before the passing test receipt.

admissibility_argument: The method caches only provably invariant local text-derived values with fail-closed identity/storage/weight lifecycle keys and bounded branch ownership. It preserves the exact cross-attention function and every video-dependent logical operation, so it is method-level lossless kernel/runtime work under the recovered goal contract.
